topology_reasoning.device_identification: Compact four-port 2x2 multimode/interference coupler. The mask is a single connected, fourfold-symmetric material region with narrow straight access guides on the left, right, top, and bottom. Each guide adiabatically opens into a broad petal/lobe; the four lobes overlap at the center, forming the coupling/interference body.
topology_reasoning.operation: Light entering one access guide expands through the taper into the central multimode overlap region, couples/interferes with the orthogonal and opposite access lobes, and exits through the other guides. The image fidelity is therefore governed by access-guide width, taper smoothness, lobe width, lobe/transfer length, and the center waist/overlap.
topology_reasoning.primitive_strategy: Represent the image as the Boolean union of four primitive path extrusions: two horizontal half-lobes and two vertical half-lobes. Each half-lobe is built only from straight gf.Path segments extruded through sine width transitions; short constant-width stem rectangles/paths define the ports. No raw polygons or device stencil components are used.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only model: four sine-tapered path-extruded lobes Boolean-unioned on layer (1,0), with exact 4.7 um by 4.7 um bbox. Stopped because IoU exceeded 0.85.

implementation_notes: Wrote final GDS without GDSFactory metadata so homi.spec_optimization layer-area verification sees the actual device as the top-level cell.
